Every name the mentor uses is in the tool results: Door (focus, place middle-left), Door's pivot at its center (place_now Door: center), Needle (proposal and watch_offer, bottom-middle), and the Anchor Point and Position properties; no times are mentioned.

rubric.reason: The mentor proposes "Needle could swing from the middle of its bottom edge", which is the snapshot's own proposal (Needle, bottom-middle), and never suggests the masked Door.

Pop, Needle, the bottom-middle place and "four days ago" all appear in the snapshot result (proposal, place, days_since_practiced: 4), and "wasn't yet full size" follows from the record's next about Pop's full-size key.

rubric.reason: Turn 2 says once, plainly, "Door isn't showing at this time, so its crosshair won't show either. Move the playhead into Door's bar first." It gives no guessed time and doesn't blame the learner, which matches the snapshot's not_on_screen note and the preview's layer_bounds_reason.

cases.title: Gauge's pivot set away from its rest key with the playhead between its Rotation keys: the away-from-rest hint (rest time named), not 'moved with the pivot'

rubric.reason: Turn 2 names Gauge's rest key at 3.167 s before the try; Turn 3 says the pivot did land on the bottom-middle, that the playhead was at 3.6 s (the check's time) where Gauge is partway through its turn, then asks for Edit > Undo first and only then for the playhead on 3.167 s, with no guessed side.

Gauge, bottom-middle, 3.167 s and 3.6 s all match the snapshot and check results, and 'level, and at full size' and 'partway through its turn' follow from the check's basis 'both' and at_rest false.
